overview: The board voted to recommend the adoption of the Medford Square District Zoning Amendment to the City Council. It also opened and continued public hearings on a retail conversion at 85 Main Street and a proposed Tufts University aquatic center at 130 College Avenue.

items.title: 85 Main Street Site Plan Review
items.summary: Continued to May 6 the public hearing on an application by M&E 85 Main Street LLC to convert an existing auto repair shop at a gas station into a convenience retail store with site and landscaping improvements.

items.title: 130 College Avenue Site Plan Review (Tufts Aquatic Center)
items.summary: Continued to May 6 the public hearing on Tufts University's Dover Amendment application to construct a 45,800-square-foot all-electric aquatic center and tennis team facility. Board members and residents raised concerns regarding parking capacity, College Avenue pedestrian safety, and the architectural scale of the southern brick wall facing the athletic fields.

items.title: Medford Square District Zoning Amendment
items.summary: Closed the public hearing and voted to recommend that the City Council adopt the revised Medford Square District Zoning Amendment text dated April 15, 2026, and zoning map dated March 23, 2026. Revisions addressed upper-story step backs along High Street, daylight and shadow study standards, and historic preservation incentives.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Upcoming Business
items.summary: Discussed departmental staffing updates, procedures to give board members earlier notification of new filings, and upcoming preliminary planning work on zoning for the Boston Avenue and Tufts campus area.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes from December 17, 2025, and January 7, 2025.
